children: Comtech reported fiscal 2026 net sales of $249.6 million and adjusted EBITDA from continuing operations of $20.6 million, as gross margin expanded to 38.9%. The company generated $37.4 million of consolidated operating cash flow in fiscal 2026 and ended the year with consolidated liquidity of $61.3 million. Management announced a definitive agreement to sell most of the Satellite and Space Communications business and plans to focus the remaining company on Allerium public-safety and retained cyber training services.
Operating loss from continuing operations (FY2026): $(18.2) million.
Adjusted EBITDA from continuing operations (FY2026): $20.6 million (8.3% of net sales).
Consolidated liquidity at year-end: $61.3 million; cash flows provided by operations (FY2026): $37.4 million (consolidated) and $25.0 million from continuing operations.

Strategic transaction: entered definitive agreement to sell most of the Satellite and Space Communications business for a base cash purchase price of $157.5 million (subject to adjustments); $10.0 million advance received and used to prepay debt.
Refocus on Allerium: post-sale company to concentrate on mission-critical public safety communications (Allerium) plus retained cyber security training and related services.
Backlog and revenue visibility: funded backlog of $520.4 million and revenue visibility of approximately $862.0 million as of July 31, 2026.

Product and market momentum: launched Allerium Mira (cloud-agnostic call handling) and Allerium Coral (network-native critical information exchange); notable renewals and statewide wins including Arizona NG9-1-1 and expanded services in Kentucky.

Operational improvements: six consecutive quarters of consolidated positive operating cash flow; anticipated transition costs of $13.0–$15.0 million (mostly FY2027–2028) with expected annual cost savings of $16.0–$18.0 million after ~1 year of transition implementation.

title: Comtech reports FY2026 revenue $249.6M, Adjusted EBITDA $20.6M; liquidity $61.3M
